facts: Tuesday evenings from 6 PM to 10 PM generated $1,900 in sales for the month.
During that Tuesday evening period, we normally scheduled 4 staff members.
The total staffing cost for those Tuesday evening shifts was $2,500 for the month, equal to $625 per staff member for that affected monthly period.
Friday evenings used the same staffing level of 4 people, but generated $6,200 in monthly sales.
The owner is willing to test reducing Tuesday evening staffing by 1 person while keeping the rest of the schedule unchanged.
Ingredient waste is currently measured at 9%.
The business's stated internal waste target is 5%.
Ingredient purchases for the waste-tracked category were $12,500 during the same month.
For delivery orders, average revenue per order was $18.40.
Some delivery orders had combined platform fees, packaging, discounts, and food costs that exceeded the revenue from the order.
The business has not yet identified or approved a specific controllable change for delivery pricing, fees, packaging, discounts, minimum order size, or menu pricing.
